outcome: Termination recommendation rates before and after teratological counseling
cohort: The study included 461 pregnant women exposed to radiation and 213 pregnant women without radiation exposure, selected from a group of 10,784 individuals who applied for teratological consultation.
finding: Preterm birth and termination rates differed significantly between cases and controls, and teratological counseling significantly decreased termination decision rates after clarifying misinformation.
cross-section timing: Data collected between 2009 and 2018 at the time of application for teratological consultation.
